description: Adds the two pitch inputs together and shifts them by octaves, semitones and cents, for tuning a voice or transposing a sequence

params.text: Shifts the pitch in octaves, -7 to 7 by default; the range and whether it snaps to whole octaves are both on the menu
Shifts the pitch in semitones, -12 to 12 by default, the hover text reading it in cents; the range and the snapping are both on the menu
Shifts the pitch by up to a semitone either way, the hover text reading it in cents

inputs.text: A pitch to be tuned, one volt per octave; it is added to the other pitch jack
A pitch to be tuned, one volt per octave; it is added to the other pitch jack
A modulation input scaled at 5V to the semitone, meant for small pitch movements rather than for notes

outputs.text: The sum of the two pitch inputs, the fine input and the three knobs, clamped to -12V and 12V

notes: the output is clamped to -12V and 12V, which is 24 octaves, so the module can transpose much further than any oscillator will follow
the polyphony of the output is the largest channel count of the three inputs
menu: Octave range: 3 (±1) to 15 (±7) — sets how far the octave knob reaches
Snap octaves — makes the octave knob move in whole octaves rather than smoothly
Semitone range: 3 (±1) to 25 (±12) — sets how far the semitone knob reaches
Snap semitones — makes the semitone knob move in whole semitones rather than smoothly
